definition: Bookings remaining after the configured test/demo filter.
not_a_claim: Not a count of referral-attributable bookings.

definition: Filtered bookings sharing exact client + lead_id with at least one referral.
decision_use: Shows where the time-order gate has evidence to evaluate.
not_a_claim: Not a conversion or bypass rate.

definition: Bookings with at least one time-valid referral under the primary route.
decision_use: Conditional cohort for strict honored and primary review rates.

metric: Strict honored rate among eligible bookings
definition: Eligible bookings whose recorded booking source is REFERRAL.
decision_use: Checks recorded attribution inside the eligible path.
not_a_claim: Does not prove commission payment or ownership.

metric: Primary review rate among eligible bookings
definition: Eligible bookings that are not strictly honored.

metric: Primary review cases per 1,000 filtered bookings
definition: Primary review cases scaled to the filtered production-like booking base.
decision_use: Headline estimate of routine Ops review workload.
not_a_claim: Not a commission-loss or fraud rate.

definition: Primary review bookings with multiple prior referrers or timeline ambiguity.
decision_use: Shows ownership ambiguity that requires manual review.

definition: Secondary exact encrypted-identity matches outside the primary route.
not_a_claim: Does not change the primary review count.

definition: Same-enquiry records where booking time precedes referral time and sources disagree.
decision_use: Data Integrity backlog for chronology repair.
not_a_claim: Never primary bypass evidence or unpaid commission count.

definition: Sum of recorded agreement values for Tier B cases, retained with quality flags.
not_a_claim: Not commission, loss, margin, or recoverable impact.

definition: Median of recorded Tier B agreement values, including values that retain a separate sanity flag.
decision_use: Reduces the influence of one very large recorded value during case review.
not_a_claim: Not commission, loss, margin, or recoverable impact.

definition: Smallest recorded Tier B agreement value, retained with quality flags.
decision_use: Provides the lower bound of the review-queue transaction context.
not_a_claim: Not commission, loss, margin, or recoverable impact.

definition: Largest recorded Tier B agreement value, retained with quality flags.
decision_use: Highlights records that need source-value verification before prioritization.
not_a_claim: Not commission, loss, margin, or recoverable impact.

definition: Tier B cases whose agreement value looks like a keyboard-pattern placeholder.
decision_use: Prompts value verification without removing the case.
not_a_claim: Does not invalidate the attribution review by itself.

metric: Tier B missing agreement value flags
definition: Tier B cases without a usable recorded agreement value.
decision_use: Shows whether source-value verification is required before value context can be reviewed.
not_a_claim: Does not invalidate the attribution review by itself.

metric: Tier B non-positive agreement value flags
definition: Tier B cases with a zero or negative recorded agreement value.
decision_use: Prompts source-value verification without suppressing the attribution case.
not_a_claim: Does not invalidate the attribution review by itself.
